a16z-base-power-company:ashbyhq:b4800338.description: ABOUT BASE Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time. ABOUT THE ROLE Base is scaling the future of energy, and we’re looking for a Journeyman Electrician who thrives in the field. You will be on-site daily—pulling wire, opening panels, troubleshooting real problems, and setting the standard through action. You are the technical backbone of our Houston, TX battery fleet. While you’ll guide others, your primary value comes from doing the work yourself and doing it right. What You'll Do You will be actively involved in the field every day, including: - Hands-On System Diagnostics: Personally troubleshoot and repair complex electrical and battery system failures in the field. - Quality & Compliance: Perform rework to ensure installs pass inspection and meet internal quality benchmarks. - On-Site Authority Representation: Meet inspectors and AHJs in the field, walk installs with them, and resolve issues in real time. - Crew Mentorship: Onboard and provide hands-on training for new installation crews to maintain high performance. - Expert Oversight: Maintain deep mastery of Base hardware, NEC Codes, and general electrical principles. - Emergent Support: Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation to address urgent night/weekend electrical issues. What You'll Bring - Credentials: Valid Residential Wireman or Journeyman Electrician license. - Experience: 4+ years of relevant electrical work, specifically with battery backups, EV chargers, or whole-home generators. - Mindset: A "fix-it-right-the-first-time" attitude and the ability to explain technical concepts to both crews and inspectors. - Communication: Ability to clearly explain work and corrections to installers, inspectors, and homeowners. Benefits - Wireman: $32/hr - $37hr. - Journeyman: $37/hr - $39/hr. - Advance your career: enjoy competitive compensation, benefits, and clear opportunities for professional growth. About This Team The Installers team is a fast-moving group of problem-solvers who believe great systems are built in the field—not on paper. We value people who show up, take ownership, and do the hard work day in and day out. As part of the Houston, TX team, you’ll bridge engineering intent with real-world execution, ensuring every Base installation sets the bar for the industry. Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive. OUR VALUES - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules. - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing. - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset. - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results. - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information. - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We are all-in. - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things. DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. greylock-payjoy:lever:8c000364-5871-4890.description: About PayJoy PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success. Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system. Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth. This role As the StaffEngineer for Cloud Infrastructure and Developer Productivity, you will lead the development and operations of a robust AWS and Kubernetes-based platform. This platform serves as the backbone for all backend applications at PayJoy, ensuring scalability, resilience, security and cost efficiency. You will play a key role in designing and implementing new features, optimizing workflows, and empowering developers to deliver their best work. In addition to leading the technical aspects, you will be responsible for maintaining the infrastructure for Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) and supporting developers with onboarding, troubleshooting, and incident management. This role will require close collaboration with cross-functional teams, to understand their evolving needs and ensure the platform adapts accordingly. With a deep emphasis on automation, performance, and reliability, you will help create a streamlined development and deployment environment that maximizes the productivity of all technical teams.

Develop and Enable Code Quality Standards: Design and implement platform features and enhancements to meet application and developer needs, prioritizing code scalability, cost optimization, and automated testing. Write and review code to ensure it meets high standards of quality, robustness, and scalability. Act as a technical mentor, providing guidance to team members on writing efficient, maintainable code, including reviews and paired programming as necessary.

Lead CI/CD and DevOps Practices: Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines, including Docker image creation, Kubernetes deployment artifacts, and environment provisioning.
